_metadata.purpose: Simulated refactoring changes that remove obsolete functions
_metadata.inject_at: After D-05 implementation complete, before D-06 as-built comparison

refactoring_changes.rationale: Redundant - Stripe API validates payment cards automatically during payment processing

root_cause_analysis.description: After integrating with Stripe payment gateway, discovered that Stripe validates card numbers, CVV, expiration dates automatically. Our ValidatePaymentCard function duplicates this functionality and adds unnecessary latency.
evidence: Stripe API documentation confirms validation is automatic
Performance testing shows 50ms latency improvement without duplicate validation
Code review identified duplicate validation logic
root_cause_analysis.decision: Remove ValidatePaymentCard function, rely on Stripe's built-in validation

documentation_affected.action_required: Remove section or update to note Stripe handles validation

functional_architecture.update_dependencies: Remove any dependencies on this function

interface_registry.action: No changes (function was internal, not part of interface)

expected_drift.after_removal: 6 functions in architecture, 5 functions in implementation

refactoring_changes.rationale: Superseded by external Avalara Tax API - more accurate, handles all tax jurisdictions

root_cause_analysis.description: Our in-house tax calculation logic only handled US sales tax and was inaccurate for complex jurisdictions. Avalara Tax API provides comprehensive, up-to-date tax calculations for all US and international jurisdictions.
evidence: Tax calculation errors identified in 3 states with complex jurisdiction rules
Avalara provides real-time tax rates for 11,000+ jurisdictions
Cost-benefit analysis shows Avalara is cheaper than maintaining in-house tax logic
Legal compliance requires accurate tax calculations - Avalara reduces liability
root_cause_analysis.decision: Remove CalculateTax function, integrate with Avalara Tax API, remove TaxService entirely

code_removed.replaced_with: External Avalara API call via HTTP

service_removed.reason: No longer needed - Avalara handles all tax calculations

tests_affected.action_required: Delete test (function no longer exists) or replace with Avalara integration test

documentation_affected.action_required: Delete entire document (feature removed) or replace with Avalara integration guide
Remove or update to mention Avalara integration

functional_architecture.update_dependencies: Remove dependencies on this function from ProcessPayment flow

interface_registry.action: Remove tax_calculation interface entirely (no longer exists)

interface_contracts.action: DELETE FILE - interface no longer exists

expected_drift.after_removal: 6 functions in architecture, 4 functions in implementation, 1 interface in architecture, 0 interfaces in implementation

service_contracts: Remove ValidatePaymentCard and CalculateTax from contracted_functions list
Update LLM warnings to reflect new function count

tests: Update integration tests that reference removed functions
docker_deployment: Provide docker cleanup commands to remove old TaxService images
build_scripts: Remove TaxService build steps from Makefile/build.sh (if applicable)

markdown_docs: Update README.md if it references removed features

instructions_for_agent_b.when_to_inject: After completing D-05 (service implementation), before starting D-06 (as-built comparison)
instructions_for_agent_b.how_to_inject: Simulate refactoring by removing the 2 functions from implementation. This creates drift where ARCHITECTURE > IMPLEMENTATION (obsolete entries in architecture).
instructions_for_agent_b.critical: After removing functions, D-06.5-A02.5 should detect the removals, and D-06.5-A03.5 should clean up ALL references (architecture, contracts, tests, docker configs).
instructions_for_agent_b.user_pain_point: Emphasize docker cleanup - 'The container is running an old image' problem must be addressed with explicit cleanup commands.
